headlines.headline: LEBRON JAMES PICKS 76ERS FOR 'LAST DECISION' OF HIS CAREER, JOINING EMBIID AND JAYLEN BROWN ON A STACKED PHILADELPHIA ROSTER
headlines.detail: LeBron James signed a two-year, $8 million deal with the Philadelphia 76ers, calling it his 'last decision' after considering retirement, and will pair with Joel Embiid and newly-acquired Jaylen Brown; separately, Portland acquired All-Star guard Ja Morant from Memphis in a trade.

headlines.headline: SAINTS LOCK UP CHRIS OLAVE WITH FOUR-YEAR, $132 MILLION EXTENSION AS TRAINING CAMP HOLDOUTS CONTINUE LEAGUE-WIDE
headlines.detail: New Orleans signed wide receiver Chris Olave to a four-year, $132 million extension as camps entered their second week, while Atlanta's Bijan Robinson and Detroit's Jahmyr Gibbs remain out seeking new deals after Jalen Carter's four-year, $152 million Eagles deal reset the market last week.

headlines.headline: BIG TEN MEDIA DAYS CLOSE WITH INDIANA'S CURT CIGNETTI AND NEW MICHIGAN COACH KYLE WHITTINGHAM HEADLINING FINAL SIX
headlines.detail: The final day of Big Ten Media Days in Chicago featured reigning national champion Curt Cignetti of Indiana alongside new Michigan head coach Kyle Whittingham, Nebraska's Matt Rhule, Maryland's Mike Locksley, Northwestern's David Braun, and Washington's Jedd Fisch.

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL WINDS DOWN WITH OVER 2,700 PLAYERS MOVED AS OLE MISS LANDS AUSTRALIAN GUARD BEN HENSHALL
headlines.detail: More than 2,700 players entered the men's college basketball transfer portal during the shortened 15-day window, with Ole Miss landing 22-year-old Australian guard Ben Henshall, a 2025 NBA Draft Combine standout expected to start immediately for Chris Beard.
